production.promptEn: touch-and-go, nail-biting; (___하게) just barely, by a hair
production.contextHint: mimetic adjective

cloze.en: Our team won by a single point, just barely.

mnemonic: 양산 = 대량 생산 squeezed: mass production. 양산을 쓰다 (to carry a parasol) is a different 양산.
meanings: (fig.) to churn out, spawn (in large numbers)

examples.ko: 이 부품은 내년 하반기부터 본격적으로 양산된다.
examples.en: Full-scale mass production of this part begins in the second half of next year.

examples.ko: 그런 정책은 결국 비정규직만 양산할 거예요.
examples.en: That kind of policy will just end up churning out more temp workers.

production.promptEn: to mass-produce; (fig.) to churn out (often critical)
production.contextHint: the 양산 that blocks the sun is a parasol (陽傘)

meanings: to restore, repair (to the former state)

examples.ko: 삭제된 파일도 복구할 수 있는 경우가 많아요.
examples.en: Deleted files can often be recovered.

examples.ko: 수해 지역의 도로는 사흘 만에 임시로 복구되었다.
examples.en: Roads in the flood zone were temporarily restored within three days.

production.promptEn: to restore (to its former state: damaged roads, deleted files)
production.contextHint: health or trust is 회복; infrastructure and data are ___

examples.ko: 헬기가 산 중턱에 추락했다는 속보가 떴다.
examples.en: A breaking report said a helicopter had crashed halfway up the mountain.

examples.ko: 그 사건 이후로 회사 이미지가 바닥까지 추락했어요.
examples.en: Since that incident, the company's image has hit rock bottom.

production.promptEn: to crash, fall from a height (a plane, a person); (fig.) to plummet
production.contextHint: sinking into a lower status is 전락

meanings: to be involved (in), have a hand in

collocations.en: to have a hand in an incident

examples.ko: 그는 그 프로젝트에 처음부터 깊이 관여해 왔다.
examples.en: He has been deeply involved in the project from the very start.

examples.ko: 저는 그 결정에 전혀 관여하지 않았어요.
examples.en: I had no part in that decision at all.

production.promptEn: to be involved in, have a hand in (a matter or decision)
production.contextHint: being part of it; stepping in from outside is 개입
